Edge-to-edge atlas, no margins, no gaps, no frames, no room view, no perspective. All sixteen posters DISTINCT with their own vibrant drawn print design and illustrated objects appropriate to students ages 11-15. Realistic printed poster graphic art, attractive limited ink palettes, rich hand-drawn shapes, paper texture. Each poster title large clearly legible accurate French; no other text, no times or contact information.
Strict row-major mapping:
Top row, left to right: "CLUB JOURNAL" newspaper reporting with notebook and student press; "JEUX DE SOCIÉTÉ" board-game pawns dice and game board; "CLUB HANDBALL" dynamic handball ball goal and athlete; "ATELIER THÉÂTRE" stage curtain and dramatic masks.
Second row: "CLUB ÉCHECS" chess pieces and board; "CLUB PHOTO" camera and photographs; "CLUB MUSIQUE" musical instruments and notes; "ÉCO-CLUB" environmental leaves recycling nature.
Third row: "ATELIER BD" comic drawing pens and panels; "CLUB SCIENCES" chemistry astronomy and laboratory symbols; "CLUB LECTURE" books and reader; "CLUB CINÉMA" film reel clapperboard cinema.
